🀄 TileMatch

A grid of face-down tiles contains matching pairs. Free, no ads, no login — play instantly on Bytecade Games.

How to Play

  1. Click a tile to flip it face-up.
  2. Click another tile — if it matches, both stay open.
  3. If it doesn't match, both tiles flip back over.
  4. Memorize the positions of revealed tiles to plan your next clicks.
  5. Clear all pairs to complete the puzzle.
